titleVi: Nhân cách, Tính cách & Các Hình mẫu Tâm lý Học thuật
themeSummaryVi: Hệ thống tính từ tính cách C2 tinh vi nhất: phân biệt sắc thái uyên bác, hiếu chiến, thất thường, nịnh bợ, kiên định và câu chuyện The Hopeless Romantic.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Pleasantly easy to approach and talk to; friendly, cordial, and warmly courteous.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Niềm nở, ân cần, hòa nhã, cực kỳ dễ gần và tạo cảm giác ấm cúng.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Despite his monumental academic stature, the professor remained disarmingly affable to all freshmen.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A warm golden glowing aura welcoming nearby floating particles into a harmonious shared orbit.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Conspicuously uninvolved and distant; maintaining cold psychological detachment.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A crystalline frost barrier pushing away all incoming particles into outer darkness.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Hostile, aggressive, and eagerly combative; actively seeking confrontation.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Hiếu chiến, ngổ ngáo, hung hăng hiếu thắng và luôn chực chờ cãi vã.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: His belligerent demeanor during the committee debate alienated even his most steadfast supporters.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: Jagged crimson spikes projecting outward and clashing violently with neighboring energy fields.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Intended to placate, pacify, or reconcile opposing factions.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: Gentle soothing ripples dissolving abrasive shockwaves into tranquil stillness.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Given to sudden and unaccountable changes of mood, whims, or unpredictable behavior.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Thất thường, đồng bóng, sáng nắng chiều mưa, hoàn toàn không thể đoán trước.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Working under such a capricious editor meant that praised drafts were torn up the very next morning.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A wildly erratic lightning bolt zigzagging arbitrarily between opposite magnetic poles.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Resolutely firm, unwavering, and constant in direction and purpose.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: An immovable granite obelisk beaming a continuous, laser-straight beacon.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Having or showing profound knowledge gained from extensive reading and academic research.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Uyên bác, thông thái sâu rộng, tinh thông kinh sử và kiến thức học thuật đỉnh cao.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Her erudite monograph on Byzantine trade networks transformed medieval historiography.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A radiant crystal tower projecting intricate geometric lattices of illumination across the horizon.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Lacking knowledge, awareness, or academic sophistication.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A dense murky fog extinguishing flickering sparks of insight.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Subject to sudden or volatile changes of mood or mind; highly animated and volatile.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Tính khí như thủy ngân, biến đổi tâm trạng mau lẹ trong chớp mắt.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: The directors mercurial temperament kept the entire theater troupe perpetually on edge.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: Droplets of liquid quicksilver splintering and recombining at dizzying speeds.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Enduring pain, hardship, or emotional upheaval without displaying feeling or complaint.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A silent stone mountain standing tranquil against howling freezing blizzards.

schemaItems.definitionEn: A servile, self-seeking flatterer who acts obsequiously toward someone important to gain advantage.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Kẻ xu nịnh, luồn cúi bợ đỡ cấp trên để mưu cầu tư lợi cá nhân.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Surrounded by spineless sycophants, the CEO never heard an honest word of critical appraisal.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A crawling subservient shadow clinging parasitically to the hem of an oversized luminary.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: An independent-minded individual who refuses to conform to a group or party line.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A solitary blazing comet carving its own fearless trajectory through the cosmos.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A deeply learned academic possessing vast intellectual mastery.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Học giả uyên thâm, nhà nghiên cứu thông tuệ kinh sách.
collocationPairs.example: He is an extremely erudite scholar of marine ecosystems, renowned worldwide.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A person enamored with idealistic notions of love despite all cynical reality.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Kẻ lãng mạn vô phương cứu chữa (luôn tin vào tình yêu màu hồng cổ tích).
collocationPairs.example: The painful rejection did nothing to extinguish the spark of the hopeless romantic within Jeff.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: An assertive, unbending belief asserted as incontrovertible truth without evidence.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Niềm tin giáo điều bảo thủ khăng khăng không nghe ai.
collocationPairs.example: Her dogmatic conviction that she alone held the truth made constructive dialogue impossible.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A rudely brief and brusque rejection.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Sự xua đuổi cộc lốc, gạt phắt đi một cách cộc cằn lạnh lùng.
collocationPairs.example: Her curt dismissal of his proposal crushed whatever fragile confidence he had mustered.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A person who is highly sociable, fond of company, and thrives at parties.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Người hướng ngoại thích giao du tiệc tùng, chan hòa kết bạn.
collocationPairs.example: Being a gregarious socialite, he drew immense energy from crowded artistic salons.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: Calm, impassive resilience in suffering adversity without complaint.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Sức chịu đựng khắc kỷ, điềm tĩnh trước nỗi đau mà không than vãn.
collocationPairs.example: Her stoic endurance during years of grueling medical treatment inspired the whole ward.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: An appetite or desire that is impossible to satisfy or quench.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Cơn thèm khát không thể thỏa mãn, khao khát vô độ.
collocationPairs.example: Jeff possessed an insatiable appetite for poetry and romantic literature.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A hasty, superficial look without paying attention to detail.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Cái nhìn lướt qua hờ hững, cái liếc mắt chiếu lệ.
collocationPairs.example: She barely spared him a cursory glance as she swept out through the conservatory doors.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Kẻ nịnh bợ luồn cúi bợ đít
domainSortItems.clueEn: A person who praises powerful people in order to get their approval.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Kẻ lập dị đi ngược dòng số đông
domainSortItems.clueEn: An unorthodox or independent-minded person who refuses to conform.
A person who is fanatical and uncompromising in pursuit of religious or political ideals.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Kẻ bịp bợm lừa đảo giả danh chuyên gia
domainSortItems.clueEn: A person falsely claiming to have a special knowledge or skill; a fraud.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Chuyên gia sành sỏi thẩm định nghệ thuật
domainSortItems.clueEn: An expert judge in matters of taste and fine art.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Người ẩn sĩ sống ẩn dật lánh đời
domainSortItems.clueEn: A person living in solitude as a religious discipline or personal preference.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Người thực dụng hành động vì hiệu quả thực tế
domainSortItems.clueEn: A person who is guided more by practical considerations than by ideals.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Kẻ lười nhác trốn tránh lao động
domainSortItems.clueEn: Wanting to avoid activity or exertion; habitually lazy.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Kẻ bốc đồng hành động thiếu suy nghĩ
domainSortItems.clueEn: Acting or done quickly and without thought or care.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Kẻ dối trá gian manh bất lương
domainSortItems.clueEn: Not telling the truth; habitually lying and dishonest.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: To throw / Dramatic actors troupe / Rigid plaster casing
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Dàn diễn viên nhạc kịch / Băng bột cố định xương / Phóng cái nhìn hoài nghi
sentences: The director assembled an exceptionally star-studded theatrical ___ for the West End premiere.
After breaking his wrist during the rugby scrimmage, his arm was placed in a plaster ___.
She couldn't help but ___ a suspicious look toward the nervous stranger in the foyer.
nuanceNotes: Performing arts: collective group of performers.
Orthopedics: rigid supportive dressing for fractured bones.
Gaze: directing a sharp glance or shadow.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Disposition / Heat treatment to harden metal / To moderate with restraint
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Tính khí nóng giận / Tôi luyện kim loại / Tiết chế giảm bớt thái độ
sentences: Under sustained provocation, the ambassador completely lost his ___ and slammed the microphone.
Blacksmiths repeatedly quench and heat steel to properly ___ the blade for battle.
Senior diplomats warned that ambitious rhetoric must be ___ed with pragmatic reality.
nuanceNotes: Metallurgy: hardening alloy through thermal cycling.
Rhetoric: softening or moderating an extreme stance.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Burial tomb / Utterly serious and weighty / Solemn accent mark
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Ngôi mộ an nghỉ / Cực kỳ nghiêm trọng khẩn cấp / Nét mặt trầm ngâm
sentences: Every November, pilgrims placed fresh wreaths of rosemary beside the soldier's ___.
The surgeon emerged from the operating theater with a deeply ___ expression on his face.
Violating sovereign airspace carries ___ geopolitical consequences for bilateral treaties.
nuanceNotes: Affect: somber, alarming, or solemn demeanor.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: To present a threat or question / Photographic stance / To feign an attitude
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Tạo dáng chụp ảnh / Đặt ra mối đe dọa tiềm tàng / Giả vờ tỏ ra ta đây
sentences: The models held a dramatic avant-garde ___ under the studio strobe lights.
Cybersecurity specialists warn that quantum computing will ___ unprecedented risks to encryption.
He struck an intellectual ___ by carrying unread philosophical tomes in public.
nuanceNotes: Risk analysis: presenting or constituting a hazard.
Social pretension: affecting an artificial persona.

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: The sheer ___ (mendacious) of the deposed prime ministers testimony stunned the investigative committee.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Mendacity là danh từ C2 chỉ sự dối trá, tính xảo ngôn trơ trẽn.

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: The envoys unprovoked ___ (belligerent) doomed what was supposed to be a diplomatic peace summit.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Belligerence là danh từ chỉ thái độ hung hăng khiêu khích.

morphologicalFamilies.meaningVi: Khắc kỷ, chịu đựng không than thở
morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: She endured the excruciating setbacks with admirable ___ (stoic), never once uttering a complaint.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Stoicism là chủ nghĩa khắc kỷ, tinh thần điềm tĩnh chịu đựng nghịch cảnh.

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: The panel was captivated by the profound depth of her scholarly ___ (erudite).
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Erudition là danh từ C2 chỉ sự uyên bác và kiến thức học thuật thâm sâu.

personaCards.meaningEn: Warm, polite, pleasant, and exceptionally easy to talk to.
personaCards.meaningVi: Hòa nhã, ân cần, hòa đồng dễ mến.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Distant, detached, and cold in social interactions.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Gracious Diplomat disarms hostile tensions with genuine warmth!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Affable (hòa nhã, thân thiện dễ gần) đối lập trực tiếp với aloof (lạnh lùng, xa cách, trịch thượng).

personaCards.meaningEn: Fiercely argumentative, aggressive, and spoiling for a brawl.
personaCards.meaningVi: Hiếu chiến, thích gây hấn hung hăng.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Peacemaking, eager to appease and harmonize.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Warlord roars and initiates an all-out confrontation!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Belligerent (hiếu chiến hung hăng) bị khắc chế triệt để bởi tính cách hòa giải ôn tồn (conciliatory).

personaCards.meaningEn: Whimsically erratic, impulsive, and constantly shifting moods without warning.
personaCards.meaningVi: Sáng nắng chiều mưa, bốc đồng thất thường.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Unwavering, constant, and rock-solid in resolve and loyalty.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Chaos Monarch abruptly reverses the kingdom's decrees on a whim!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Capricious (thất thường, thay đổi xoành xoạch) đối lập với sự kiên định vững chãi (steadfast).

personaCards.meaningEn: Possessing profound scholarly learning and vast intellectual mastery.
personaCards.meaningVi: Bậc học giả thông tuệ kim cổ, trí tuệ uyên thâm.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Lacking basic knowledge, uneducated, and illiterate in deep matters.
personaCards.battleScenario: The High Archon analyzes opponent weaknesses through ancient treatises!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Erudite (uyên bác thông thái) đối lập tuyệt đối với sự ngu ngơ vô tri (ignorant).

personaCards.meaningEn: An obsequious flatterer who curries favor with the powerful for gain.
personaCards.meaningVi: Kẻ ton hót luồn cúi bợ đít quyền lực.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: A fierce nonconformist who defies authorities and carves an independent path.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Courtier showers the ruler in honeyed false praise to secure promotion!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Kẻ bợ đỡ nịnh thần (sycophant) bị khắc chế bởi cánh chim độc lập không chịu luồn cúi (maverick).

personaCards.meaningEn: Exceedingly idealistic, unrealistic, and chasing romantic impossibilities.
personaCards.meaningVi: Lãng mạn hảo huyền viển vông như Đông Ki-sốt đánh cối xay gió.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Grounded in sensible, realistic, and practical calculations.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Knight charges full gallop at insurmountable imaginary windmills!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Quixotic (mơ mộng viển vông, hảo huyền phi thực tế) đối lập với pragmatic (thực tế, tỉnh táo và hữu dụng).

personaCards.meaningEn: Enduring immense hardship or agony without displaying outward emotion.
personaCards.meaningVi: Người khắc kỷ, điềm nhiên trước bão giông thử thách.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Volatile, wildly expressive, and emotionally unpredictable.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Sentinel absorbs a thunderous blow without blinking an eye!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Stoic (điềm đạm khắc kỷ, vững như bàn thạch) đối nghịch với mercurial (dễ dao động, xúc cảm thất thường).

personaCards.meaningEn: A fanatical and uncompromising partisan in pursuit of radical dogmas.
personaCards.meaningVi: Kẻ cuồng tín mù quáng, bất chấp lý lẽ.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: A reasonable person favoring centrist compromise and calm restraint.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Inquisitor brandishes an unyielding manifesto that condemns all dissent!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Zealot (kẻ cuồng tín cực đoan) bị khắc chế bởi người theo chủ nghĩa ôn hòa chừng mực (moderate).

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: It was rather ___ of Jeff to believe that a simple bouquet would make the neighbor girl fall into his arms.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Ingenuous là ngây thơ, khờ dại, chất phác thiếu trải đời; Ingenious là tài tình, khéo léo, phát minh thông minh.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: At first when I gently tried to ___ an answer from his bruised lips, he stared vacantly at the ceiling.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Elicit là động từ khơi gợi, moi ra thông tin; Illicit là tính từ chỉ hành vi phi pháp, trái luật.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: Despite her public image as an approachable leader, in private meetings she appeared distant and decidedly ___.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Aloof là xa cách, lạnh lùng, không hòa đồng; Affable là niềm nở, thân thiện, dễ bắt chuyện.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: The headmaster suspended the student not for being lazy, but for his openly ___ and disrespectful backtalk.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Insolent là láo xược, xấc xược thô lỗ; Indolent là lười nhác, lười biếng chảy thây.

narrativeChronicle.title: Story: The Hopeless Romantic
narrativeChronicle.subtitleVi: Chuyện Chàng Khờ Si Tình — Bi Kịch & Hy Vọng Của Jeff
narrativeChronicle.settingDescription: Downs Road suburban cul-de-sac. Poor Jeff has nursed an unrequited infatuation for Martha Higgins for five long years.

segments.promptTextBefore: Ever since the Joneses moved into 37 Downs Road, poor Jeff had been hopelessly
segments.promptTextAfter: with Martha Higgins, the neighbors daughter.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Jeff wanders into dreamland, convinced that his five-year schoolboy crush is cosmic destiny.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Infatuated with someone là say mê đắm đuối đến mờ mắt vì ai đó.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Being merely mesmerized describes momentary sensory fascination, not a five-year chronic emotional obsession.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Mesmerized chỉ trạng thái bị hớp hồn nhất thời, không đi liền với cụm tình cảm lâu năm 'infatuated with'.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Martha was an 18-year-old girl who barely knew Jeff existed; claiming she seduced him is an outrageous fabrication!
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Seduced là bị dụ dỗ quyến rũ thể xác, hoàn toàn sai lệch tính cách tình cảm đơn phương trong sáng của Jeff.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Saying he was merely entertained reduces high-stakes puppy love to an afternoon circus show.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Entertained chỉ mang tính giải trí thư giãn, không thể hiện tình yêu cuồng nhiệt.

segments.promptTextBefore: Martha became more and more of an enigma. She had a strong
segments.promptTextAfter: for the Arts, and it wasn't long until Jeff also developed an insatiable appetite for poetry.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Jeff buys half the Shakespeare canon overnight in a desperate bid to appear erudite before Martha.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: A penchant for something là sở thích mãnh liệt, niềm thiên hướng đam mê nghệ thuật.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Saying she had a likeness for the arts sounds like her face physically resembles an oil painting.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Likeness là sự tương đồng về ngoại hình hoặc bức chân dung, không phải sở thích.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: An affirmation for the arts sounds like Martha is a tax auditor certifying an art exhibition grant.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Affirmation là sự khẳng định xác nhận, không dùng chỉ sở thích cá nhân.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Turning Martha's artistic soul into a brainteaser makes her sound like a Sunday Sudoku booklet.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Brainteaser là câu đố mẹo trí tuệ, hoàn toàn lạc quẻ.

segments.promptTextBefore: Jeff professed his undying devotion on her doorstep, but instead of embracing him, a terrified Martha kedonked him fairly
segments.promptTextAfter: over the head with a wooden mallet!

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: BONK! Poor Jeff crumples onto the porch with a lump the size of an apple throbbing on his temple.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Viciously miêu tả cú đập mạnh mẽ, dữ dội và tàn nhẫn của chiếc búa gỗ tự vệ.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: A tame tap with a mallet would not knock a teenage boy unconscious onto the pavement for two hours.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Tamely là nhu mì yếu ớt, không giải thích được chấn thương bầm dập của Jeff.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Kedonking someone infrequently sounds like Martha strikes him on the head once every leap year.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Infrequently là hiếm khi, không miêu tả được cường độ của một cú nện búa tức thời.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: You cannot accidentally wind up a wooden mallet and strike an admirer squarely on the skull.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Văn cảnh bài đọc cho thấy cô bé hoảng loạn vung búa tự vệ dữ dội (viciously).

segments.speakerOrMood: Big Brother (Shaking Head in Resigned Awe)
segments.promptTextBefore: Just when all seemed lost, Martha arrived with flowers and a get-well card. Instantly, the spark of the hopeless romantic was

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Despite the gargantuan concussion, Jeff is already scheming his next grand romantic gesture!
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Rekindle a spark là collocation C2 chuẩn xác nhất chỉ việc nhen nhóm lại ngọn lửa tình cảm.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Resuscitate applies to a drowned patient needing oxygen, not a poetic spark in a boy's heart.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Resuscitate là hô hấp nhân tạo ép tim, dùng cho tia sáng tình yêu là lạc phong cách.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Revamping Jeff's romantic spark makes it sound like a discounted living room furniture set.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Revamp là tân trang sửa chữa nội thất/hệ thống, không dùng cho cảm xúc thiêng liêng.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Resurrected makes Jeff's infatuation sound like a terrifying zombie climbing out of a suburban grave.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Rekindled là cách kết hợp tự nhiên nhất với 'spark of the hopeless romantic'.
